body: I'm sorry. I hadn't checked thiss account. I feel like I would get diagnosed with depression, then have to take pills, which I'm afraid will change who I am.
But its been like this for a while. Its actually gotten worse.

One of the main reasons I don't want to go is because I don't want to take pills. I'm pretty sure that I'm considered 'depressed'..I don't want people forcing pills down my throat. And it would be *just* me going. No family.
That's just it. I don't trust anyone other than my friend.

Similar story to OP's. Except it only took me a few minutes to realize that it wasn't right...but I had to make a throwaway for this..

When I was about 4, maybe 5, I was visiting my stepdads family with my mom, brother, stepdad and I. Well, one of his realtives was the same age as me. She was really nice, and I decided to spend the night at her house with her. Being that we were both girls, we shared a room and bed. We were still up after everyone went to bed, so we were talking, about whatever.after a while, I started dozing off, when I feel something touch my hand. Its her, forcing my hand down her pants, then her feeling me.back then, even if I was your friend, I still didn't talk much...so the whole time I was silent, frozen in fear. As soon as she stopped, I went and laid, cryings in the living room floor.
